fullContentHtml:

The BARC Scientist Result 2026 has been released by the Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC) on 10th April 2026. The exam authority has also released the BARC Scientist scorecard 2026 on 15th April. Applicants can download the scorecard through email ID and password/date of birth. The examination was conducted on 14th and 15th March 2026. This recruitment is carried out to select eligible candidates for Scientific Officer posts under the OCES programme in various disciplines. The BARC Scientist Result is released for various disciplines such as Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Geology, Physics and others at barcocesexam.in. Candidates who were shortlisted for the written test will go for Interview, conducted within 12th May to 12th June 2026.

BARC Scientist Result 2026 Out

The BARC OCES Result has been released in PDF Format at barcocesexam.in for candidates who appeared in the exam for Scientific Officer (Group-A) posts through OCES 2026 and DGFS 2026 programmes. Over 1,20,000 candidates have applied and around 70,000 to 85,000 candidates appeared in the online test. The written exam was conducted for 2 hours, computer-based.

BARC Scorecard 2026 Out

Bhabha Atomic Research Centre has released the BARC scorecard 2026 on the official website. Candidates can download the scorecard through the login window using their registration number and password/date of birth. Aspirants can check their personal details, marks in individual subjects, qualifying status, raw marks and other information. Candidates are advised to keep their scorecard PDF safe till the conclusion of the recruitment process.

How to Download the Official BARC Scientist Result 2026 PDF?

The BARC OCES Result 2026 can be downloaded from the official website at barcocesexam.in. Candidates need to check the result carefully to confirm their selection for the next stage.

  • Visit the official website barcocesexam.in
  • Click on the link “BARC Scientist Result 2026 PDF” on the homepage
  • Open the result PDF for your discipline
  • Use Ctrl + F and enter your application number
  • Check your result status and download the PDF for future use

Details Mentioned on the BARC OCES Result 2026

The BARC Scientist Result includes important information related to the shortlisted candidates. Candidates should carefully check all the details mentioned in the result PDF.

  • Application number of shortlisted candidates is listed for identification
  • Name of the discipline such as Physics, Chemistry, Geology etc. is mentioned
  • Result status showing whether the candidate is shortlisted for interview
  • Category details of candidates, if applicable, are included
  • Name of the recruiting authority, BARC, is mentioned in the result PDF

Expected BARC Scientist Cut Off Marks 2026

The BARC OCES Cut Off Marks 2026 are prepared based on previous year trends, exam difficulty and number of candidates appearing in the exam. The cut off marks are usually moderate to high because of the large number of applicants and limited vacancies.

What’s Next After the BARC Scientist Result 2026?

After the BARC Scientist Result 2026 is declared, shortlisted candidates move to the next stages of the selection process. These stages include interview slot booking, selection interviews and final merit list.

DGFS Final Selection List 2nd week of July 2026

BARC Scientist Result 2026 FAQs

Q1. When was the BARC Scientist Result 2026 released?

Ans: The BARC Scientist Result 2026 has been released on 10th April 2026 on the official website for all disciplines.

Q2. How can I check the BARC OCES Result 2026?

Ans: Candidates need to vist the barcocesexam.in website. Scroll to the result section and download pdf.

Q3. What details are there in the BARC Scientist Result 2026?

Ans: The result PDF includes application numbers of shortlisted candidates, discipline name, result status and authority details.

Q4. What is the next stage after the BARC Scientist Result 2026?

Ans: Candidates who qualify the written test are shortlisted for the Interview stage which will be conducted from 12th May to 12th June 2026.

Q5. How many candidates appear for the BARC OCES exam every year?

Ans: Around 70,000 to 85,000 candidates appear for the exam every year out of more than 1,20,000 applicants, making it highly competitive.
